theorems.name: Submission.br_la_weaklyConvergesOn_of_flat_decomposition
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Pk S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), X ω - Pk k ω = (R k).boundary ω + S k ω) → Tendsto (fun k => (R k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => (S k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → WeaklyConvergesOn Pk X
